title: A standardized protocol for the isolation and culture of normal and arthritogenic murine synovial fibroblasts
protocol: Euthanize the mice using carbon dioxide according to institutional guidelines.
Rinse microdissecting instruments with 70% ethanol and then immerse them in an antimicrobial solution for a few seconds.
Repeat the decontamination step of the instruments after cutting off the joints of each mouse.
Place the mouse in the face-up position and rinse it with 100% ethanol.
Peel back the skin and remove soft tissues from the hind legs using scissors and forceps.
Cut ankle joint off before the tibial muscle including the toes, and spray again with 100% ethanol.
Place ankle joints in a tube filled with HBSS and antibiotics.
Repeat steps 4-6 for all joints.
Place the cut joints into a 100mm tissue culture plate containing 70% ETOH for some seconds.
Transfer the joints to an HBSS-containing dish.
Place one joint in a fresh empty 100mm dish and cut through the joint space with the scalpel.
Hold each toe digit with the scalpel and pull with the forceps.
Avoid smashing the bones so as to prevent contamination by bone marrow cells.
Repeat steps 8-9 for all joints.
Prepare fresh and filtered collagenase IV in HBSS at a concentration of 10 mg/ml.
Add 18 ml of DMEM containing 10% FCS to the plate with processed tissue from 3 mice.
Place dissected joints and tissue in 50 ml tubes with 2 ml of collagenase IV solution (final concentration of 1 mg/ml in DMEM 10% FBS, 1% L-Glutamine, and 1% Pen/Strep).
Incubate tissues with collagenase solution at 37°C for 50 minutes to 1 hour at maximum shaking speed.
Vortex vigorously after incubation to release cells.
Transfer supernatant to a new 50 ml tube.
Place 20 ml of fresh DMEM in the original tube containing digested joints and repeat procedure, adding supernatant to the new tube.
Centrifuge tubes at 1100 rpm for 10 minutes at room temperature.
Re-suspend cell pellet in fresh DMEM supplemented with 10% FBS, 1% L-Glutamine, and 1% Pen/Strep.
Seed tissues/cells into 100 mm dishes (dissected tissue from one mouse per dish or flask).
Place seeded dishes in a humidified tissue culture incubator at 37°C and 5% CO2.
Monitor isolated cells daily.
Change medium every 3 days.
Be careful not to remove the small pieces of tissue during the first week after isolation.
Remove floating pieces of tissue once groups of cells are observed.
Trypsinize when confluence reaches 90-100% of the plate.
Transfer cells to a 150mm plate or 175cm² flask at a split ratio of 1:2.
Incubate with pre-warmed trypsin for 2-4 minutes for fibroblast detachment.
Change flasks/plates in every passage.
